name: Masoor Dal Tadka
ingredients: ½ cup (100 g) whole or split red lentils (masoor), rinsed
Tadka: 1 tsp oil, ½ tsp cumin seeds, 2 garlic cloves (sliced), 1 dried red chilli, pinch of hing
steps: Boil the lentils with turmeric, tomato and water for 15–18 minutes until completely soft. Whisk lightly.
Add salt and adjust the consistency with hot water.
For the tadka, heat the oil, crackle the cumin, then add garlic, chilli and hing until the garlic turns golden.
Stir in the chilli powder, then pour the tadka over the dal.
Finish with lemon juice and coriander.
note: Red lentils cook quickly without soaking.
